summary: One typed Python handle for 20 SQL and analytical engines: the same code connects, inspects, queries and writes against SQLite or DuckDB locally and Postgres, Snowflake, BigQuery, Trino and others in production, with installs scoped by extra and explicit transaction control.

Portable writes: upsert, add_columns, indexes across dialect families
